scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @nextray/frontend" "npm run dev -w @nextray/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nextray/backend && npm run build -w @nextray/frontend
scripts.build:render: npm install --include=dev && npm run build:api && npm run db:setup:api
scripts.start: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,green "npm run start -w @nextray/frontend" "npm run start -w @nextray/backend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @nextray/shared && npm run test -w @nextray/backend && npm run test -w @nextray/frontend
